decisions.quote: In Brief Study Design. A replication association study that used genomic data generated from French-Canadian case and control cohorts. Objectives. To determine whether the 53 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that were previously associated with spinal deformity progression in an American Caucasian cohort are similarly associated in French-Canadian population.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. The available primary source is an abstract only and states that 52 of 53 single nucleotide polymorphisms from the ScoliScore test previously associated with spinal deformity progression in an American Caucasian cohort were retested in a French-Canadian cohort with no association found. However, the abstract contains no in-text citations or reference list to identify the specific originating report for the American Caucasian ScoliScore cohort. Shipped row 1129 (Ward et al., 2010, 'Validation of DNA-Based Prognostic Testing to Predict Spinal Curve Progression in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis', DOI 10.1097/brs.0b013e3181ed2de1) is a plausible candidate for that original study, but the abstract alone cannot resolve whether row 1129 is the exact cited target work or whether a different discovery report is cited in the full article.
